mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_correction (id, report_id, parse_version_base, new_parse_version, reviewer_id, patches_json, idempotency_key, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{reportId}, #{parseVersionBase}, #{newParseVersion}, #{reviewerId}, #{patchesJson}, #{idempotencyKey}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT id, report_id AS reportId, parse_version_base AS parseVersionBase, new_parse_version AS newParseVersion, reviewer_id AS reviewerId, patches_json AS patchesJson, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, created_at AS createdAt FROM report_correction WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
